description:
If you've recently watch any of the videos floating around the internet talking about buying a "boring business", it's no secret that these boring businesses - HVAC, Plumbing, Home Services - can be profitable enterprises. But the truth is that the operations side of these businesses are far more complex than is often represented in these videos. In this video you hear the truth from Sara Sharp, a deal attorney that works in Mergers and Acquisitions ever single day, about what it's actually like to buy one of these businesses. Sara works with business owners every day that are exiting these types of businesses, and she can tell you the struggles they face and why they're exiting.

For more information on Deal Academy, a program that teaches you how to buy and sell accounting practices, click the link here:
